{{Quote|Speaking of the Rebellion, did anyone else notice the YT-1300 transport sitting in bay forty on our way in?|Joak Quiller|<ref name="COO">''[[Choices of One]]''</ref>}}
'''Bay Forty''' was a landing bay within [[Whitestone City spaceport]] in [[Whitestone City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Poln Major]]. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] docked the ''[[Millennium Falcon/Legends|Millennium Falcon]]'' in Bay forty during a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Battle for Poln Major|mission]] to the planet.<ref name="COO" />
